title: Statues
style: A sneaky tiptoe theme played like a game of musical statues - every time Hazel turns around, the music cuts dead; it restarts when she turns away. Opens into a warm, wide orchestral sunrise.
rules: Original instrumental only. No vocals, no lyrics, no spoken word.

hit_points.cue: Sneaky pizzicato and bassoon theme starts on the first hop.
Music stops dead on the double-take.
Pizzicato tiptoe theme restarts quietly, muted trumpet on each peek.
Silence from the needle scratch until the thud; a single low bassoon note after.
Theme stops on the fall; restarts with a cheeky muted-trumpet 'wah' on the reveal.
Music stops on the skid; a single comic oboe 'boop' when eyes close.
Theme in rapid bursts that stop on each glance, getting faster each time.
Low wordless choir pad swells softly, the sneaky theme is gone.
Full orchestral sunrise in E major, horns and strings, choir pad blooms.
One reprise bar of the sneaky theme played slowly and tenderly on bassoon, ending on a soft E major chord at the cut.

end_card.cue: Music resolves on the final chord exactly at the cut; ODDLY sting plays over 2.0s end card.
